1_worker.notes: All 6 LLM calls serialized. TTFT dominates.

2_workers_m1_only.notes: M1 only, no HP. Still serial on M1 GPU.

2_workers_hp_only.notes: HP only, no M1. Network latency + slower aggregate.

4_workers_distributed.notes: OPTIMAL - M1(2) + HP(2) parallel. Design notes generate concurrently.

6_workers.notes: REJECTED - Ollama queue contention, TTFT degradation on M1.

8_workers.notes: Model interference, RAM pressure, quality degradation.

load_balancing.balance_assessment: Good - M1 handles heavy reasoning (ornith9b + qwen7b), HP handles cheap secondary coding (qwen3b). No worker starvation observed.
load_balancing.task_stealing: Not needed - work is pre-assigned by model affinity. M1 workers get M1 models, HP workers get HP models.

retry_behavior.retry_notes: If an LLM call fails, the worker retries once. If it fails again, the pipeline fails fast. No silent retries.

conclusion: 4 workers (2 M1 + 2 HP) is the optimal configuration. Worker creation overhead is negligible (50ms). Load is well-balanced by model affinity. No task stealing needed. Beyond 4 workers, Ollama queue contention and model interference degrade performance.
